sections.text:
In a wide, beautiful pasture full of fresh green grass, a flock of fat sheep was grazing peacefully under the supervision of an attentive shepherd and his strong, loyal dog.

There was an evil and hungry wolf watching the herd from atop a nearby hill for several days, salivating in the hope of eating a delicious ewe.

But the wolf could not approach, because the strong dog was guarding the flock day and night, and the shepherd always carried his gun.

The wolf tried to sneak in more than once, and each time the dog discovered him and chased him to the edge of the forest.

The cunning wolf realized that force and direct attack would not succeed, so he decided to use trickery and cunning to reach his goal.

One day, while the wolf was wandering in the forest looking for an idea, he found an old sheep skin that some hunters had left behind after they had skinned it.

A malicious idea flashed in the wolf's head; He decided to wear this skin to disguise himself as a sheep, and enter the flock without anyone noticing him!
Indeed, the wolf carefully put on the sheep's skin, making sure to cover his pointed ears and long tail, and then he walked slowly and swayed like sheep do.

When he approached the herd, the dog did not notice anything strange, and the shepherd thought it was just one of his sheep that had moved away a little, so he returned to the herd.

The plan worked perfectly! The wolf entered among the sheep and began to pretend to eat grass with them, while he was waiting for nightfall to pounce on his prey.

Some of the sheep felt that there was something strange about this new sheep. Its smell did not resemble their smell, and its size was somewhat large.

An innocent little sheep approached the disguised wolf and asked him: “Hello, where do you come from? We have never seen you before in our flock.”

The wolf almost preyed on the little sheep at that moment, but he controlled himself and said in a soft, artificial voice: “I am a new sheep that the shepherd bought today from the nearby hill market.”

The little sheep believed the story, and the wolf continued to hide until complete darkness fell, and the shepherd brought his flock into the barn and closed the door to rest and sleep.

The wolf was very happy. He was now alone with all these sheep inside a closed place, and he began preparing to choose the fattest ewe to eat and then escape out the window.

But what the wolf did not expect was that the shepherd had decided that very night to slaughter a sheep to serve as dinner for important guests who would arrive in the morning!
The shepherd entered the dark barn carrying a sharp knife, and he did not carry a lantern so as not to disturb the sleeping sheep.

The shepherd began to feel the sheep in the dark, looking for the fattest and largest sheep among them to slaughter.

The shepherd felt the sheep one by one, until his hand fell on the wolf in disguise!
The shepherd felt that this “sheep” was very large and fat, so he was happy with it, and grabbed it forcefully by the neck, and before the wolf realized what was happening, the shepherd had slaughtered it with his sharp knife!
When the shepherd lit the lantern to see the sheep he had slaughtered, he was greatly shocked to find that it was a huge wolf wearing a sheep's skin!
The shepherd understood the malicious trick that the wolf used, and thanked God that this cunning person had met his punishment before he harmed any ewe from his flock.

Since that day, the proverbial wolf in sheep's clothing has become a hypocritical person who pretends to be good and innocent to hide his evil and destructive intentions.
